name: promega-workspace
description: Promega Workspace for every Promega employee — shaped for the Promega Project Planner V3 Visualizer (Windows Electron desktop app, filesystem-only). Works for scientists, lab technicians, QA, manufacturing, operations, sales, HR, IT, and anyone at Promega who wants to organize their work in the Visualizer. Creates a Personal Workspace with Projects/ and Meetings/ mounts plus optional add-ons. Outlook meeting sync via Microsoft 365 Plus with full transcript and recording support. Three-tier knowledge search (workspace → SharePoint → general). /save-summary and /save-note for knowledge capture. /add-project for scaffolding new work. Uses the Microsoft 365 Plus connector — requires it enabled in Claude Customize.
